SELECT t.id, ifnull(u.user_name, '神秘用户') as userName, u.avatar, t.content, t.score, t.create_time as createTime, t.user_id as userId FROM taking_commnt t LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON t.user_id = u.user_id WHERE 1=1
and t.order_taking_id = #{takingId}
and u.user_name like concat('%',#{userName},'%')
and u.phone like concat('%',#{phone},'%')
and t.content like concat('%',#{content},'%')
and t.user_id=#{userId}
order by t.create_time desc

SELECT t.id, ifnull(u.user_name, '神秘用户') as userName, u.avatar, t.content, t.score, t.create_time as createTime, t.user_id as userId FROM taking_commnt t LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON t.user_id = u.user_id WHERE t.order_taking_id in (select id from order_taking where user_id=#{userId}) order by t.create_time desc

SELECT t.id, ifnull(u.user_name, '神秘用户') as userName, u.avatar, t.content, t.score, t.create_time as createTime, t.user_id as userId FROM taking_commnt t LEFT JOIN order_taking o ON o.id = t.order_taking_id LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON o.user_id = u.user_id WHERE t.user_id=#{userId} order by t.create_time desc
select score / counts from (select ifnull(sum(score), 0) as score, count(*) as counts from taking_commnt where order_taking_id = #{orderTakingId}) a
select avg(score) from taking_commnt where order_taking_id in (select id from order_taking where user_id = #{userId})
